installCommand: npm i -g --allow-scripts=pnpm pnpm@12.1.0 && export PATH="$(npm prefix -g)/bin:$PATH" && cd ../.. && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --filter pokedex-rest...
buildCommand: export PATH="$(npm prefix -g)/bin:$PATH" && pnpm build && if [ "$VERCEL_ENV" = "preview" ]; then node dist/run-migrations.js; fi
